IDENTITY MODEL: the canonical source records the configured agent principal's SYMBOLIC OS account name in a protected record, with (uid, gids) resolved LIVE from pwd/grp at every recognition -- the only model that detects post-provision privilege-group drift and UID reuse; pwd/grp span macOS and Linux and the OS account database is already inside the trusted computing base (HPAC-PAWA-REQ-018).
